name: Data table
description: Any table as a clean, readable board: a league table, savings rates with their small print, stock levels, a timetable. Connect a Google Sheet, CSV, REST list or Manual table (or type the rows in), pick the columns, colour cells with simple rules like "On hand < 5 red", and long tables page themselves.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: preset
params.label: Starting point
params.help: Fills in sample rows, a title and highlight rules for any of those you leave empty. Choose "None" to use only your own settings.

params.name: title
params.label: Title
params.help: Empty uses the starting point's title. Type a single - to hide it.

params.name: subtitle
params.label: Subtitle
params.help: One line under the title. Empty uses the starting point's. Type a single - to hide it.

params.name: footer
params.label: Footer line
params.help: Small text along the bottom. Empty uses the starting point's. Type a single - to hide it.

params.name: disclosure
params.label: Disclosure / small print
params.help: Shown small under the table on every page, e.g. the legal wording rates must carry. Empty uses the starting point's. Type a single - to hide it.

params.name: table
params.label: Table data source (optional)
params.help: A Google Sheet, CSV, REST list or Manual table. Its header row becomes the column headings. Replaces the typed rows below.

params.name: rows
params.label: Typed table
params.help: Used when no data source is connected. First line = headings, then one row per line, cells separated by |. Empty shows the starting point's sample.

params.name: show_columns
params.label: Columns to show
params.help: Optional, comma-separated headings in the order you want them, e.g. Team, P, Pts. Empty shows every column.

params.name: highlight_col
params.label: Highlight column
params.help: The heading of the column the rules below test. Empty uses the starting point's. Type a single - for no highlighting.

params.name: highlight_rules
params.label: Highlight rules
params.help: Separated by ; and tried in order, e.g. < 5 red; < 20 amber; = Sold out grey. Colours: red amber green blue purple grey accent or #hex (or those colours in your language).

params.name: rows_per_page
params.label: Rows per page
params.help: 0 = automatic: everything on one screen when it is readable, otherwise pages of a comfortable size.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: Title rule, heading row, page dots and the "accent" highlight colour.

params.name: show_updated
params.label: Show when the data source last updated
params.help: Only with a connected data source.

params.name: updated_label
params.label: "Updated" label
params.help: The word before the update time. Empty uses "Updated" in the screen's language; a single - shows the time alone.

params.name: limit_label
params.label: Note when not every row fits
params.help: Shown when the data source has more rows than reached the screen; {shown} and {total} are filled in. Empty uses "First {shown} of {total} rows" in the screen's language.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The language of the board's own words and sample tables, the update time and page numbers. Empty uses the screen's language.
